name: FFS_ST_ACTY_KEY_DICT
description: Dictionary of activity keys for travel statistics.

columns.name: KEY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for Activity Travel key value.

columns.name: KEY_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the Activity Travel key.

columns.name: TRAVEL_AVG
columns.description: Average value of traveling time calculated based on all reported records.

columns.name: TRAVEL_12_WEEKS_AVG
columns.description: Average value of traveling time for the last 12 weeks.

columns.name: TRAVEL_4_WEEKS_AVG
columns.description: Average value of traveling time for the last 4 weeks.

columns.name: TRAVEL_1_WEEK_AVG
columns.description: Average value of traveling time for the last week.

columns.name: TRAVEL_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of records used to calculate the traveling time.

columns.name: TRAVEL_12W_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of activities used to calculate travel_4_weeks.

columns.name: TRAVEL_4W_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of activities used to calculate travel_4_weeks.

columns.name: TRAVEL_1W_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of records used to calculate the traveling time.

columns.name: TRAVEL_KEY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of unique origin travel keys in these records.

columns.name: TRAVEL_12_WEEKS_KEY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of unique origintravel keys in these records.

columns.name: TRAVEL_4_WEEKS_KEY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of unique origintravel keys in these records.

columns.name: TRAVEL_1_WEEK_KEY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of unique origin travel keys in these records.

columns.name: COORD_ACTIVITY_COUNT
columns.description: Number of activities used to calculate cood_x/coord_y.

columns.name: COORD_X
columns.description: X coordinate (Longitude) of the center of the Activity Travel Key.

columns.name: COORD_Y
columns.description: Y coordinate (Latitude) of the center of the Activity Travel Key.

columns.name: COORD_X_MEDIAN
columns.description: Median of all x co-ordinates of the travel key.

columns.name: COORD_Y_MEDIAN
columns.description: Median of all y co-ordinates of the travel key.

columns.name: SPEED
columns.description: Average speed within the travel key.

columns.name: PARKING_TIME
columns.description: Average parking time within the travel key.

columns.name: SPEED_OVERRIDE
columns.description: Customer provided speed override (in km/hr) for the travel key.

columns.name: PARKING_TIME_OVERRIDE
columns.description: Customer provided parking time override (in minutes) for the travel key.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_KEY_TYPE
columns.description: Key ID of the Appointment Travel Key.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SLR_CORRECTION_PARAMETER
columns.description: Travel key level correction value (in minutes) that is calculated and stored by the Stats Wizard SLR correction script and added to the travel time obtained from the map provider.
